recipes.name: Blank
recipes.summary: Empty starter recipe. One field, one no-op stage. Replace contents of pipelineDsl with your own simulation.

recipes.name: Weather (example)
recipes.summary: Forcing-driven weather pipeline. Single attractor; useful as a baseline.

recipes.name: Gray-Scott (example)
recipes.summary: Two-field reaction with asymmetric diffusion. Knobs gsFeed/gsKill walk Pearson's f/k phase diagram.

recipes.name: Discharge cascade (example)
recipes.summary: Excitable medium with discrete discharge events via where(). Knob dischargeThreshold walks silent / intermittent / runaway-cascade regimes.

recipes.name: Inverter front (example)
recipes.summary: A wave propagates by threshold-spread (one cell/tick); cells the wave passes through fire an event that swaps substances A and B locally. Closes the events trilogy alongside discharge-cascade and residue-tracks: events that *modify* underlying continuous fields.

recipes.name: FitzHugh-Nagumo (example)
recipes.summary: Excitable medium. Fast u spikes through a cubic threshold; slow v recovers and suppresses. Diffusion turns spikes into traveling fronts; an asymmetric seed breaks a front into a rotating spiral.

recipes.name: Belousov-Zhabotinsky (example)
recipes.summary: 3-field oscillating chemistry. u is the fast autocatalyst, v is the medium-timescale inhibitor, w is the slow tertiary recovery. Three timescales produce nested target waves and rotating spirals.
